record.paper_title: Seven open problems in applied combinatorics
record.context_brief: 4-uniform hypergraph s-t cuts with convex split penalty
record.original_question: Let H=(V,E) be a 4-uniform hypergraph with source node s and sink node t. For a bipartition {S,̄S} with s∈S and t∈̄S, let ∂_i(S) be the set of hyperedges having exactly i vertices on the smaller side of the cut, and assign penalty w_i≥0 to each hyperedge in ∂_i(S), with w_0=0. The cardinality-based hypergraph s-t cut problem minimizes Σ_i w_i |∂_i(S)| subject to s∈S and t∈̄S. When w_1=1, determine the computational complexity of this problem in the regime w_2>2.

evidence.quote: Edges with i nodes on the small side of the cut are denoted by ∂i(S) = {e ∈ E : min{|e∩S|, |e∩S¯|} = i}. ... The cardinality-based hypergraph s-t cut problem is given by (1) min_S⊆V Σ_i wi |∂i(S)|, subject to s ∈ S and t ∈ S¯.
Open Problem 3.1. What is the complexity of the cardinality-based 4-uniform hypergraph s-t cut problem when w2 > 2 and w1 = 1?

artifact.self_contained_problem: Let H=(V,E) be a 4-uniform hypergraph (every hyperedge e∈E satisfies |e|=4) with two distinguished vertices s,t∈V. For a bipartition {S, V∖S} with s∈S and t∈V∖S, and for each hyperedge e∈E, define the split index of e by min{|e∩S|, |e∩(V∖S)|} ∈ {0,1,2}. For i∈{0,1,2}, let ∂_i(S) = { e∈E : min{|e∩S|, |e∩(V∖S)|} = i }. Fix nonnegative weights w_0, w_1, w_2 with w_0=0, and define the cut cost f(S) = w_0|∂_0(S)| + w_1|∂_1(S)| + w_2|∂_2(S)|. The cardinality-based 4-uniform hypergraph s-t cut problem asks to compute min{ f(S) : s∈S ⊆ V, t∉S }. Fix w_1 = 1. Determine the computational complexity of this minimization problem in the parameter regime w_2 > 2.
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work establishes that the cardinality-based 4-uniform hypergraph s-t cut problem with w_1=1 is NP-hard for every w_2 > 2, resolving the question. The submodular regime w_2 ∈ [1,2] is known to be polynomial-time solvable; outside it (including w_2 > 2 and w_2 ∈ [0,1)) the problem is NP-hard.

status_evidence.title: Improved Hardness and Approximations for Cardinality-Based Minimum s-t Cuts Problems in Hypergraphs
status_evidence.snippet: Specifically for 4-uniform hypergraphs we show that the problem is NP-hard for all w2 > 2.
status_evidence.claim: The complexity question for 4-uniform hypergraph cardinality-based s-t cut with w1=1 and w2>2 is resolved as NP-hard.

status_evidence.title: On the tractability and approximability of non-submodular cardinality-based s-t cut problems in hypergraphs
status_evidence.snippet: Companion work addressing tractability/approximability of non-submodular cardinality-based hypergraph s-t cut problems.
status_evidence.claim: Recent literature confirms hardness results for non-submodular regimes of cardinality-based hypergraph s-t cuts.
